style.styleTitle: Personalised Me To You Couples Christmas Bauble by PMC by PMC
style.toneOfVoice: This Personalised Me to You Christmas Couple's Bauble is sure to take pride of place on the recipient's Christmas tree! Personalise this bauble with a line of text on the front of up to 25 characters and with a year up to 4 characters. The reverse of the bauble can be personalised with a message over 4 lines, with up to 25 characters per line. All personalisation will appear in fixed upper case on the front of the bauble. The reverse of the bauble is case sensitive and will appear as entered. As such, please avoid entering your personalisation on the back of the bauble in block capitals. This bauble comes supplied with a ribbon ready to hang straight onto the tree. The colour of ribbon may vary.
